title: Among K–12 schools with enrollment (K–12) over 400 and located in counties
question: Among K–12 schools with enrollment (K–12) over 400 and located in counties where at least one school has a mailing city of 'Fresno', find the school with the lowest total SAT score (sum of Math, Reading, and Writing). Return its grade span offered, county, free meal eligibility rate for students aged 5–17, and the name of its top administrator (first and last name).

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    s."XCL_074",
    s."XCL_045",
    f."XCL_025" / f."XCL_024",
    s."XCL_080",
    s."XCL_081"
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f."XCL_001" = s."XCL_041"
JOIN satscores AS t ON t."XCL_030" = s."XCL_041"
WHERE f."XCL_019" > 400
  AND s."XCL_045" IN (
    SELECT s2."XCL_045"
    FROM schools AS s2
    WHERE s2."XCL_055" = 'Fresno'
  )
ORDER BY (t."XCL_037" + t."XCL_038" + t."XCL_039") ASC
LIMIT 1
